text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers and machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognizing images, solving problems, and making decisions. A key part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of being explicitly programmed for every task. Going a step further, deep learning uses complex neural networks inspired by the human brain to handle even more challenging tasks, like translating languages or driving cars. In daily life, AI is already everywhere—from voice assistants on your phone to recommendation systems on streaming services and spam filters in your email. It helps with navigation, online shopping, and even medical diagnosis.
